name: kopai/kopai-get-started
summary: Get a project that `kopai setup` just connected to Kopai Cloud sending its first telemetry. Checks the connection, instruments the app through the otel-instrumentation skill, launches it with `kopai run` so the token stays out of sight, proves data arrived, and reports. Use when `./.kopairc` has an `otlp` block and the user says "add observability", "confirm telemetry reaches Kopai", "get started with Kopai", or pastes the prompt from the Kopai dashboard's Get started page. Do NOT use against a local `@kopai/app` backend (use otel-instrumentation), to investigate telemetry for a cause (use root-cause-analysis), or to build dashboards (use create-dashboard).
